evidence: The text states: 'A controllable ALD process for Li xMn2O4 was found by combining Mn(thd) 3, Li(thd), and ozone. The lithium content and crystalline phase of the films as a function of amount of lithium subcycles in the deposition sequence were studied. Furthermore, we studied film properties of ALD-MnO 2 and V 2O5 subjected to lithium ALD treatment.'
